_meta.scenario: Successful ISV Create Payment Order for EUR 99.99
_meta.notes: OrderCode is a 16-digit int64 stored as string to preserve precision above Number.MAX_SAFE_INTEGER (2^53-1=9007199254740991). 9999999999999999 > 9007199254740991 = true, confirming bigint round-trip is necessary. Amount=9999 minor units (EUR 99.99). MerchantId scopes this to the test tenant.
